newsitem.title: GAMBIA: Iran's foreign minister visits tiny Gambia.
newsitem.headline: Iran's foreign minister visits tiny Gambia.

text.p: Iran's Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati visited the tiny West African state of Gambia on Thursday and told state television that he saw much scope for cooperation between the two countries.
Velayati, who had talks with President Yahya Jammeh, said he had invited him to a December islamic summit in Tehran.
"I believe that there is much room for cooperation between Gambia and Iran. I hope my country will open very soon an embassy in Banjul," he said.
